```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Define risk group membership per metacluster
risk_group_map <- c(
  "MC_13" = "Low-risk", "MC_17" = "Low-risk",
  "MC_8" = "High-risk", "MC_0" = "High-risk", "MC_1" = "High-risk"
)

# --- SITE plot ---
site_plot_df <- merged_df |>
  select(site, all_of(top_mc)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(top_mc), names_to = "metacluster", values_to = "abundance") |>
  mutate(mc_label = sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", metacluster)) |>
  filter(mc_label %in% names(risk_group_map)) |>
  mutate(risk_group = risk_group_map[mc_label]) |>
  filter(!is.na(site)) |>
  group_by(site, mc_label, risk_group) |>
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(abundance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(site_plot_df, aes(x = mc_label, y = mean_abund, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_abund - se, ymax = mean_abund + se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ site) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low-risk" = "#1B5E20", "High-risk" = "#B22222")) +
  labs(title = "Metacluster abundance by tumour site",
       x = "Metacluster", y = "Mean abundance", fill = "Risk group") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave("site_metacluster_barplot.png", dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 5)

# --- TREATMENT plot ---
tx_plot_df <- merged_df |>
  select(treatment_status, all_of(top_mc)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(top_mc), names_to = "metacluster", values_to = "abundance") |>
  mutate(mc_label = sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", metacluster)) |>
  filter(mc_label %in% names(risk_group_map)) |>
  mutate(risk_group = risk_group_map[mc_label]) |>
  filter(!is.na(treatment_status)) |>
  group_by(treatment_status, mc_label, risk_group) |>
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(abundance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(tx_plot_df, aes(x = mc_label, y = mean_abund, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_abund - se, ymax = mean_abund + se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment_status) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low-risk" = "#1B5E20", "High-risk" = "#B22222")) +
  labs(title = "Metacluster abundance by treatment status",
       x = "Metacluster", y = "Mean abundance", fill = "Risk group") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave("treatment_metacluster_barplot.png", dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 5)
```
```{r}
site_plot_df <- merged_df |>
  select(site, all_of(top_mc)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(top_mc), names_to = "metacluster", values_to = "abundance") |>
  mutate(mc_label = sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", metacluster)) |>
  filter(mc_label %in% names(risk_group_map), !is.na(site)) |>
  mutate(risk_group = risk_group_map[mc_label],
         mc_label = factor(mc_label, levels = c("MC_13", "MC_7", "MC_30", "MC_0", "MC_5", "MC_47")),
         group_combo = paste(risk_group, site, sep = " - ")) |>
  group_by(site, mc_label, risk_group, group_combo) |>
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(abundance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(site_plot_df, aes(x = mc_label, y = mean_abund, fill = group_combo)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_abund - se, ymax = mean_abund + se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Low-risk - colon"   = "#1B5E20",  # dark green
    "Low-risk - rectal"  = "#7CB342",  # light green
    "High-risk - colon"  = "#8B0000",  # dark red
    "High-risk - rectal" = "#E57373"   # light red/pink
  )) +
  labs(title = "Metacluster abundance by tumour site",
       x = "Metacluster", y = "Mean abundance", fill = "Risk group / Site") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        panel.border = element_blank())
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

mc_subset <- names(risk_group_map)  # MC_13, MC_7, MC_30, MC_0, MC_5, MC_47
mc_subset_cols <- top_mc[sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", top_mc) %in% mc_subset]

# --- Site Wilcoxon ---
site_results_top <- lapply(mc_subset_cols, function(mc) {
  test <- wilcox.test(merged_df[[mc]] ~ merged_df$site)
  data.frame(metacluster = mc, p.value = test$p.value)
}) |> bind_rows() |>
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) |>
  arrange(FDR)

# --- Treatment Wilcoxon ---
tx_results_top <- lapply(mc_subset_cols, function(mc) {
  test <- wilcox.test(merged_df[[mc]] ~ merged_df$treatment_status)
  data.frame(metacluster = mc, p.value = test$p.value)
}) |> bind_rows() |>
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) |>
  arrange(FDR)

site_results_top
tx_results_top

# --- Group means: site ---
site_means <- merged_df |>
  select(site, all_of(top_mc)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(top_mc), names_to = "metacluster", values_to = "abundance") |>
  mutate(mc_label = sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", metacluster)) |>
  filter(mc_label %in% names(risk_group_map), !is.na(site)) |>
  group_by(mc_label, site) |>
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = mean_abund, names_prefix = "mean_")

# --- Group means: treatment ---
tx_means <- merged_df |>
  select(treatment_status, all_of(top_mc)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(top_mc), names_to = "metacluster", values_to = "abundance") |>
  mutate(mc_label = sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", metacluster)) |>
  filter(mc_label %in% names(risk_group_map), !is.na(treatment_status)) |>
  group_by(mc_label, treatment_status) |>
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment_status, values_from = mean_abund, names_prefix = "mean_")

# --- Wilcoxon results: site ---
site_results_clean <- site_results_top |>
  mutate(mc_label = sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", metacluster),
         risk_group = risk_group_map[mc_label]) |>
  select(mc_label, risk_group, site_p = p.value, site_FDR = FDR)

# --- Wilcoxon results: treatment ---
tx_results_clean <- tx_results_top |>
  mutate(mc_label = sub(".*_MC_([0-9]+)$", "MC_\\1", metacluster)) |>
  select(mc_label, tx_p = p.value, tx_FDR = FDR)

# --- Merge into one summary table ---
summary_tbl <- site_results_clean |>
  left_join(tx_results_clean, by = "mc_label") |>
  left_join(site_means, by = "mc_label") |>
  left_join(tx_means, by = "mc_label") |>
  mutate(mc_label = factor(mc_label, levels = c("MC_13", "MC_7", "MC_30", "MC_0", "MC_5", "MC_47"))) |>
  arrange(mc_label) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

summary_tbl

# --- Render as table ---
summary_tbl |>
  kable(col.names = c("Metacluster", "Risk group",
                       "p (site)", "FDR (site)",
                       "p (treatment)", "FDR (treatment)",
                       "Mean (colon)", "Mean (rectal)",
                       "Mean (untreated)", "Mean (treated)"),
        caption = "Metacluster abundance: site and treatment comparisons")

summary_tbl |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Metacluster", "Risk group",
                       "p (site)", "FDR (site)",
                       "p (treatment)", "FDR (treatment)",
                       "Mean (colon)", "Mean (rectal)",
                       "Mean (untreated)", "Mean (treated)"),
        caption = "Metacluster abundance: site and treatment comparisons")
```
